children.name: Brachylaima fuscata  Joyeux, Baer & Timon-David, 1932
children.description: (based on 4 mature specimens). Body elongated (fig. 1, A), with maximum width 476 – 542 anterior to ventral sucker; body length 2,487 – 2,849. Oral sucker larger than ventral sucker. Oral sucker 241 – 288 × 211 – 282. Ventral sucker 150 – 182 × 145 – 180. Distance from anterior end of body to centre of ventral sucker 890 – 960. Pharynx well-developed, round, 102 – 174 × 123 – 168. Gonads in posterior quarter of body. Ovary between testes. Anterior testis 160 – 272 × 167 – 261, posterior testis 164 – 269 × 122 – 245. Ovary 131 – 162 × 136 – 171. Vitellarium distributed in two lateral fields, extending from posterior extremity of ventral sucker to level of anterior edge of anterior testis. Eggs oval, numerous, 28 – 35 × 16 – 18 in size.
